title: FedEx Thailand Named Among HR Asia’s ‘Best Companies to Work For’ for Sixth Consecutive Year
summary: Recognition highlights FedEx focus on team member well-being, work-life balance and career development in Thailand
body_markdown:
**Thailand, October 14, 2026** — FedEx Thailand has been named one of the “Best Companies to Work For” at the HR Asia Awards 2026. This marks the sixth consecutive year FedEx has received the recognition, reflecting its continued efforts to support employee well-being and development.


The HR Asia Awards honors organizations with strong human resource practices, high employee engagement and positive workplace cultures. The assessment draws on both organizational practices and direct employee feedback through HR Asia’s proprietary TEAM assessment, providing insight into employees’ workplace experience.


“A great workplace isn’t built overnight, it is nurtured every single day by how we empower and care for our team members. Our People-Service-Profit philosophy is anchored in the belief that when we support our people, they are better equipped to deliver outstanding service that builds our customers’ trust and fuels sustainable business growth. This allows us to continue investing in our people and our business,” said Sasathorn Phaspinyo, managing director, FedEx Thailand. “Being recognized for the sixth consecutive year is meaningful to us. It encourages us to continually raise the bar in creating an inclusive and empowering environment for our team members.”


The company’s culture value of “Taking care of each other” is reflected in how the company continues to invest in programs that support employee well-being, including health and wellness programs, mental health resources, training, mentorship, and continuing education opportunities. These programs are designed to empower team members to build on their skills and progress in their careers.


The latest award reinforces FedEx Thailand’s position as a leading employer in the country and highlights its ongoing focus on fostering employee well-being, continuous talent development and inclusive workplace culture.


To learn more about FedEx Thailand, please visit[fedex.com/th](https://www.fedex.com/en-th/home.html)
